title: IMD Gridded Rainfall — Assam Revenue Circles (Monthly)
description: Monthly rainfall statistics (max, mean, sum) per Revenue Circle in Assam, derived from IMD's 0.25° gridded daily rainfall product, used as a hazard input to the IDS-DRR Assam flood risk model.
purpose: Input covariate for the IDS-DRR Assam flood risk score model, capturing rainfall as a flood hazard driver.
details: Per the risk model's data dictionary (IDS-DRR-Assam-Risk-Model/RiskScoreModel/data/data_dictionary.csv): max_rain and mean_rain are licensed 'GODL' (Government Open Data License – India, IMD's own terms); sum_rain is separately marked 'CC BY 4.0' there, reflecting its republication via civicdataspace.in rather than a different upstream license. RDLS has one license field per dataset, so 'GODL' (the upstream/majority license) is used here. Temporal coverage reflects Sources/master/rainfall.csv (2018-01 to 2026-05); the raw .grd cache in Sources/IMD/data only retains a recent rolling window used for incremental updates.

sources.name: IMD Gridded Rainfall Data (0.25° daily), accessed via imdlib

gazetteer_entries.description: Assam Revenue Circles administrative boundaries (the object_id used across IDS-DRR variables) — a custom scheme, not yet a registered RDLS gazetteer.

resources.title: Monthly gridded rainfall rasters (resampled)
resources.description: Monthly summed rainfall raster for Assam, resampled from IMD's 0.25° gridded daily rainfall product to ~0.01° (~1.1km) via gdalwarp.

resources.title: Revenue Circle monthly rainfall zonal statistics
resources.description: Zonal statistics (count, mean, max, sum) of monthly rainfall per Revenue Circle in Assam, one CSV per month, computed from the resampled raster.

resources.title: Harmonized rainfall variable (master)
